function: Joint design of AP beamforming and movable-antenna positions minimizing worst-case target-position CRLB under rate constraints in cell-free ISAC with time synchronization errors (p. 6, p. 8).
system: Cell-free ISAC: 3 transmit APs with 16 movable antennas, 2 sensing APs with 4, 2 single-antenna users, 1 target; no RIS; band not stated (p. 4, p. 10).
method: MA-MetaRL: MAML meta-learning wrapped around TD3 actor-critic (reinforcement), meta-trained on random layouts then adapted to new layouts; manifold optimization (non-learned) handles TS errors (p. 8-10).
data_channel: Own simulation: geometric movable-antenna channel with 3 paths per link, path-loss exponents 2.8 and 2.2, nodes random in 100 m circle, perfect CSI (p. 4, p. 10-11).
test_conditions: Meta-training on sampled layouts, adaptation to an unseen layout; sweeps of target distance, power, number of MAs, rate threshold, TS error interval; 5 seeds (p. 8-12).
baselines: Non-learned: SCA beamforming and MA positions [6], SCA with fixed-position antennas; learned: DRL and SAC without TS-robust step [43], MA-MetaRL ignoring TS errors (ideal) (p. 11).
metrics: CRLB of target position versus power, number of MAs, rate constraint, TS error; reward and training-loss convergence (p. 11-13).
complexity: MO O(ABS Nt Nr) per iteration, MetaRL O(Nnet Nparam) per update; memory about 200 MB; runtime about 0.45 s per AO iteration on RTX 3090 (p. 10).
q1_support: p. 4: "we adopt a geometric channel model [31]"; own path-loss model on p. 11, no 3GPP, DeepMIMO or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 8: "facing an unseen layout Tnew , the agent performs the same brief TD3 update"; p. 10: "a new task is defined, and the user is randomly placed"
q3_support: p. 11: "Successive Convex Approximation (SCA)" (non-learned) and "Proposed soft actor-critic (SAC) algorithm without TS errors robust algorithm [43]" (learned); p. 13: "Compared to DRL, the improvement in CRLB of MA-MetaRL stems from its ability to mitigate overestimation bias"
q4_support: p. 10: "the total runtime per AO iteration is about 0.45 s on an NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPU"
q5_support: p. 10: "These additions ensure that the reported results are transparent and fully reproducible"; no code or data link is given and the data are self-simulated.
notes: Area 5: MA-MetaRL (MAML plus TD3) designs the ISAC beamformers and MA positions; the action includes beamformers (p. 8), so the function check passes. TS errors are handled by non-learned manifold optimization. q2 rests on the described meta-adaptation to unseen layouts; no separate result on unseen layouts is reported, so the reviewer should confirm. q3 counts DRL and SAC [43] as standard RL algorithms applied to the same problem; the paper describes both as lacking the TS-robust step, so the reviewer should confirm they are not mere variants.
